review:
A mystical voodoo shop on 25 lines, where the shopkeeper wild can land in several places at once.

The main bonus is a Mega Jackpot Hold & Win with sticky Voodoo symbols – the more you collect, the bigger the win, and full lines of them get multipliers at the end. The other bonus gives eight free spins with only high symbols. You can light enchanted candles for 2.5 times the bonus chance. Medium-high volatility, 7,500x max, 96.88% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
